title: Koutetsu no Kishi 2 - Sabaku no Rommel Gundan
aliases: Koutetsu no Kishi 2: Sabaku no Rommel Gundan
description: World War 2 turn-based strategy game developed by Dual in 1994 for the Super Famicom. It is the second game in the Koutetsu no Kishi (Steel Knight) franchise of tank-oriented strategy games.
